headlines.text: OAuth2 is the dominant auth pattern: 12 of 12 apps support it, and 8 offer both OAuth2 and a static key/token - so most toolkits need an OAuth app registration, with API keys as the quick path for single-tenant use.
Getting credentials is mostly self-serve: 83% of apps let a developer get working credentials alone (free or trial); 1 are gated by an admin, app review, partner programme or sales.
Gating clusters by category: Support and Helpdesk is the most self-serve (100%), CRM and Sales the least (80%).
The most common blocker is 'paid plan' (3 apps); 7 apps are ready today, 5 ready with caveats, 0 blocked.
MCP is already mainstream: 8 vendors ship an official MCP server and 3 more have only community servers.
Composio already has toolkits for 11 of the 12; 0 self-serve, ready apps have no Composio toolkit yet - the cheapest net-new wins.
